_comment: Requested adds 2026-08-01. Each weight is the MAKER's published spec, at the size the maker publishes it for — CAYL specs one size per product (here M), so the variant records that size rather than a size the spec doesn't cover. Two requested items were dropped, not estimated: CAYL Rip Stretch Vent Pants (CAYL publishes no weight for it, and no retailer republishes one) and a size-XL row for the CAYL Trail Air Jacket (CAYL publishes only the 134 g S-size figure already carried by windthrow-sweep-2026-07-19.json). Patagonia's 4.4-oz NetPlus figure is the FABRIC weight, not the hat's — the hat's own spec is 115 g.
